title: Butterfly dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings: upper pair -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='38' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#ff9ecb' transform='rotate(-20 35 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='38' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#ff9ecb' transform='rotate(20 65 38)'/>
  <!-- wing lighter inner patches -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='38' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ffd6ea' transform='rotate(-20 35 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='38' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ffd6ea' transform='rotate(20 65 38)'/>
  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- lower wings -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#c76bd6' transform='rotate(15 38 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='62' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#c76bd6' transform='rotate(-15 62 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#e3a6ec' transform='rotate(15 38 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='62' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#e3a6ec' transform='rotate(-15 62 62)'/>
  <!-- lower wing dots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='65' r='2.5' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='65' r='2.5' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4.5' ry='20' fill='#7be3ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='29' r='5.5' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M47 26 Q42 16 38 13' stroke='#7be3ff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 26 Q58 16 62 13' stroke='#7be3ff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='13' r='2.2' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='13' r='2.2' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars around the dance -->
  <path d='M18 22 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <path d='M82 24 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <path d='M20 78 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 z' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='76' r='2.2' fill='#ff9ecb'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='82' r='1.6' fill='#c76bd6'/>
</svg>
